llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam characteristics: it mimics the Lacoste brand while using an unrelated domain and name ('Isabella Sharo'), lacks real company and contact details (no address, no business phone, only generic email mention), offers free shipping and urgency promos, and presents a shell storefront with excessive product categories. The copyright and site structure indicate a template site, often seen in scam online shops impersonating luxury brands. These match several typical scam signals outlined above (items 1, 4, 6, 7, 16).
